messages:
Imani (PM): Quick sync idea — proposing we split Dedicated capacity launch into a two‑phase commitment model I'm calling 'lease tiling' + explicit autoscale guardrails. Need product/eng/sales alignment before Q3 planning.
Diego (Eng): curious, what do you mean by 'lease tiling'?
Imani (PM): high level: customers can buy n‑month tiles (e.g., 1m/3m/12m) that compose a longer commitment. Tiles give predictable headroom for scheduling + simpler refund/upgrade semantics. Helps offer graceful partial rollouts.
Tom (Sales): +1 from pre-sales — customers want smaller initial commits with clear upgrade path. also: billing teams asked for deterministic proration rules.
Kavita (SRE): main concern is how tiles interact with autoscale: we need bounded spillover so one tile's burst doesn't starve other tenants. propose guardrails: per‑tenant burst cap, preemptible low‑priority lane, and regional spill thresholds.
Diego (Eng): initial implementation options: (A) soft buckets (best‑effort) + backfill queue; (B) hard‑enforced reservation with preemption hooks. A is faster to ship; B gives stronger guarantees.
Imani (PM): launch criteria suggestion — we only GA the tiles + autoscale if all 4 are green: 1) end‑to‑end billing proration tests 2) demo pilot with 2 customers (one big, one mid‑market) 3) preempt behavior documented + canary 4) latency SLOs hold under 2x expected burst.
Tom (Sales): can take two customers for pilot: AcmePay (big) and Pixlink (mid). They want 3m tiles first.
Kavita (SRE): ops checklist (short):
- telemetry: per‑tile occupancy, spill events
- alerts: >10% preempt rate in 5m window
- rollback path: automatic fallback to hosted fallback pool
Diego (Eng): implementation notes: KV cache warming when tiles spin up is an issue; for 3m tiles we should prewarm session caches and support fast‑attach. Also need a fast path for releasing tiles to free up GPU memory.
Imani (PM): tradeoffs: smaller tiles = lower buyer friction but higher churn + more scheduling overhead. We need to quantify cost delta and ops burden. Diego, can eng estimate scheduler overhead for 1m vs 3m vs 12m?
Diego (Eng): will size. rough guess: 1m tiles + daily churn could add ~8–12% scheduler CPU and increase fragmentation; 12m reduces churn but is sticky.
Tom (Sales): pricing implication: maybe price‑per‑token slightly higher on 1m tiles to offset ops cost. customers usually accept a premium for flexibility.
Kavita (SRE): autoscale guardrails proposal v1:
- tenant_burst_cap: 2x baseline for 1m tiles, 4x for 12m tiles
- spill_policy: soft_spill -> attempt backfill, then preempt non‑committed lanes
- emergency_fallback: route critical QPS to hosted pool (controlled by feature flag)
Diego (Eng): technical constraints: preempt path needs graceful KV checkpoint or we risk regen cost spike. also need gated rollout flags for per‑region behavior.
Imani (PM): decision proposal: ship tiles + soft buckets (option A) in alpha with pilot customers; freeze B (hard reservations) for later phase. Gate GA on the 4 launch criteria. Everyone ok with that?
Tom (Sales): ok from sales + will manage pilot signups and expectations.
Kavita (SRE): ok, but require a short oncall runbook and a couple of chaos tests before GA.
Diego (Eng): ok — will schedule two sprints for alpha (scheduler + leak/fragmentation metrics) and mark items for B‑phase.
ops‑bot: Deployed feature flag "lease‑tiling‑alpha" to staging at 1749994500 :rocket:
Imani (PM): action items:
- Diego: estimator for scheduler overhead by 1749994700
- Kavita: draft ops runbook + chaos test plan by 1749994700
- Tom: secure pilot customers + billing acceptance by 1749994600
- Imani: write launch criteria checklist and add to roadmap by EOD
Diego (Eng): noted. I'll start with simulation for churn and attach some instrumentation.
Kavita (SRE): will add telemetry dashboards and alert thresholds.
Tom (Sales): starting pilot outreach now.
Imani (PM): thanks all — we'll reconvene next Tue to review metrics and go/no‑go. :calendar:
